role: frequency-ordered word list (full list; the app bundles its head as the seed)
generationVersion: gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (HKeyboard scripts/; Batch 5 added the hangul script filter)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang ko --script hangul --stop "톰,톰은,톰이,톰을,톰의,톰과,톰에게,톰도,메리,메리는,메리가,메리를,존" --out ko_words.txt kor_text.txt
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: tokens of Hangul syllables (eojeol - a word with its particles attached, as Korean spaces it); Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop); words seen fewer than 3 times dropped; ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: The app bundles the top 900 lines as its seed and downloads this full list on the user's request.
